answer: What keeps this honest is paired-device co-signature proof, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. One honest agent clears the check in 15 minutes; a farm of 454 pays 6810 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. One harbor of signal, one quill of cost, one whisper of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
